exposure: timing of IV cannula placement (admission, during labor/postpartum, or not at all)
cohort: The study cohort consisted of 1069 women cared for by nurse-midwives who presented in spontaneous labor.
finding: The study found that urgent IV cannulation for postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal birth was not associated with lower mean postpartum hemoglobin or hematocrit, or an increased blood transfusion rate, compared to women who had an IV cannula placed earlier in labor.
mod_finding: The findings specifically address postpartum hemorrhage after vaginal birth in relation to IV cannulation timing.
